name: Scroll Zoom Gallery
description: Vertical column of square image cards that zoom in and brighten as they pass through the viewport center, then ease back out, driven by CSS scroll timelines.
contents: Vertical list of square image cards with rounded frame and gradient overlay
Eyebrow label and title on each card
behavior: Each image scales up and goes from dim grayscale to bright color as it scrolls into view, then back out
Uses native CSS view timelines, so browsers without support show static images
Hover lifts the caption and softens the overlay
editableByProps: Number of cards, images, alt text, labels and titles

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the dim and bright filter levels during the zoom
needsCodeEdit.where: modernZoom keyframes inside the style tag
aspect-square and max-w classes on the zoom-track element

fixed: Zoom relies on CSS animation-timeline, supported in modern Chromium and Safari, other browsers show static images
Card ring and shadow use fixed white and black tones
